slides.text:
THE FBI'S
FIRST MEMO
ON ALCATRAZ

slides.label: FBI EVIDENCE · DECOY HEAD
slides.caption: Morning of 12 June 1962: guards found heads like this in three bunks. Soap, toilet paper and real hair.

slides.label: FBI MEMO · 12 JUNE 1962
slides.caption: That evening, San Francisco reported no trace of the three men: not on the island, not on the mainland, not in the water.

slides.label: FBI MEMO · ACTION
slides.caption: The memo's action line: the search "is being pressed vigorously", and San Francisco must keep FBI headquarters advised of everything.

slides.label: ADDENDUM · 13 JUNE · 7:40 AM
slides.caption: Next morning: the Coast Guard found a paddle of the type the men used, floating between Alcatraz and Angel Island.

slides.sub: The FBI closed the case in 1979. The U.S. Marshals still list it as open.
